mapper.select: select a.cm_userid, a.cm_username, nvl(a.cm_cpasswd,a.cm_dumypw) cm_cpasswd, a.cm_logindt, a.cm_ercount, a.cm_admin, a.cm_status, a.cm_active, a.cm_manid,a.cm_deptseq, a.cm_project,a.cm_project, c.cm_deptname teamname, a.cm_duty, a.cm_position from cmm0100 c,cmm0040 a where a.cm_userid= #{id} and a.cm_project=c.cm_deptcd
select b.cm_userid from cmm0040 a,cmm0040 b where a.cm_userid = #{id} and b.cm_project = a.cm_project and b.cm_active = '1'
select CM_PASSWD from cmm0010 where cm_stno='ECAMS'
select count(*) from CMM0040 where CM_USERID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE CMM0040 SET CM_CPASSWD = #{SET_PASSWD}, CM_CHANGEDT = SYSDATE, CM_ERCOUNT = 0 WHERE CM_USERID = #{SET_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT CM_PWDNUM FROM CMM0010 WHERE CM_STNO='ECAMS'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMM0041 WHERE CM_CHANGDT IN (SELECT MIN(CM_CHANGDT) FROM CMM0041 where cm_userid = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE CMM0041 SET CPASSWD = #{curPwd}, CHANGEDT = SYSDATE WHERE CM_CHANGDT IN (SELECT MIN(CM_CHANGDT) FROM CMM0041 WHERE CM_USERID = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CMM0041 (CM_USERID, CM_CHANGDT, CM_PASSWD) VALUES (#{userId}, SYSDATE, #{curPwd})
